editor.title: Screen layout
editor.intro: Arrange the screens the way they sit on your desk. The mouse crosses wherever edges touch.
editor.imported: The layout from the classic app was brought over. Adjust it and save to start using the free-form editor.
editor.foreignConfig: Deskflow currently uses your own file {file}. Saving switches it to this layout (your file isn’t deleted).
editor.pendingInLayout: {name} is already in the layout: save so it can connect.
editor.pendingMissing: {name} wants to connect but isn’t in the layout.
editor.addComputerTitle: Add a computer next to the selected one
editor.hint: Drag to move · edges and corners to resize · Shift: free size · Alt: no snapping · wheel: zoom · Ctrl+Z: undo
editor.noRoom: There’s no room for that size without overlapping another screen.
editor.savedRunning: Saved. Deskflow restarted with the new layout.
editor.savedNext: Saved. It applies the next time you start Deskflow.
name.invalid: Use letters, numbers, periods, hyphens or underscores, with no spaces.
name.taken: There’s already a computer with that name.
name.ownAlias: That’s already an alias of this computer: remove it first.
summary.unreachable_one: {names} doesn’t touch any screen connected to this one: the mouse can’t get there.
summary.unreachable_other: {names} don’t touch any screen connected to this one: the mouse can’t get there.
summary.tipClick: Click a screen to edit it.
summary.tipLines: The colored lines show where the mouse crosses.
summary.tipSize: If a screen is bigger, make it bigger here: moving between screens follows their real height.
summary.address: The other computers connect to {address} (port {port}) using the same names you see here.
screen.nameHint: Must match the name Deskflow uses on that computer.
screen.noLinks: It doesn’t touch any other screen. Move it next to one to connect it.
screen.unreachable: It’s connected to others, but none of them reaches this computer.
alias.ip: An alias can’t be an IP address.
keyboard.modifiersHint: What this computer receives when you press each key.
keyboard.macSwapHint: to control a Mac from a PC, or the other way around
keyboard.locksHint: Check one if it ends up reversed on this computer or has to be pressed twice.
advanced.xtestHint: If the cursor shows up on the wrong monitor on a computer with several monitors.
advanced.weakFocusHint: The active window doesn’t get focus as soon as you move to this computer.
aliases.title: Other names
aliases.hint: Names this computer can also connect with, for example if its network name changes.
corners.title: Dead corners
corners.hint: In the checked corners the mouse doesn’t cross to another screen. Useful for the Start button or hot corners.
